name: Banqi: net against classical
description: Twenty games at 200,000 nodes a move with the 0.3.0 net against classical. Each chapter opens into its own deal and replays under current Mistboard rules.

games.name: Game 6: classical wins
games.intro: MistyBanqi 0.3.0 net against classical, both at 200,000 nodes a move. The first flip bound red to the first seat. 81 plies, 32 flips, 23 captures. The classical engine won: the opponent had no legal move.
